question: Total property tax collected in Punjab
sql: SELECT SUM(amount_paid) FROM payment WHERE tenant_id LIKE 'pb.%' AND status = 'SUCCESS';

question: Total unpaid tax in Ludhiana
sql: SELECT SUM(d.net_demand) FROM property_tax_demand d JOIN property p ON d.property_id = p.property_id JOIN boundary b ON p.boundary_code = b.code WHERE b.name = 'Ludhiana' AND d.status = 'UNPAID';

question: Show all payments for property PB-PT-103928
Top 5 wards by tax collection
sql: SELECT b.name AS ward, SUM(p.amount_paid) AS total_collection FROM payment p JOIN property pr ON p.property_id = pr.property_id JOIN boundary b ON pr.boundary_code = b.code WHERE b.type = 'WARD' GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY total_collection DESC LIMIT 5;

question: List all active properties in Amritsar
sql: SELECT * FROM property p JOIN boundary b ON p.boundary_code = b.code WHERE b.name='Amritsar' AND p.status='ACTIVE';

question: Total tax demand for residential properties in Ludhiana
sql: SELECT SUM(d.net_demand) FROM property_tax_demand d JOIN property p ON d.property_id = p.property_id JOIN boundary b ON p.boundary_code = b.code WHERE b.name='Ludhiana' AND p.property_usage_type='Residential';

question: Owners with more than 3 properties
sql: SELECT o.name, COUNT(p.id) AS property_count FROM owner o JOIN property p ON o.id=p.owner_id GROUP BY o.id, o.name HAVING COUNT(p.id) > 3;

question: Payments made by tenant pb.amritsar in 2024-25
sql: SELECT * FROM payment p JOIN property_tax_demand d ON p.demand_id = d.id WHERE p.tenant_id='pb.amritsar' AND d.financial_year='2024-25';

question: Properties with built-up area greater than 2000 sqft
Average net demand for commercial properties
sql: SELECT AVG(d.net_demand) FROM property_tax_demand d JOIN property p ON d.property_id = p.property_id WHERE p.property_usage_type='Commercial';

question: Top 5 owners by total tax paid
sql: SELECT o.name, SUM(p.amount_paid) AS total_paid FROM owner o JOIN property pr ON o.id=pr.owner_id JOIN payment p ON pr.property_id=p.property_id WHERE p.status='SUCCESS' GROUP BY o.id, o.name ORDER BY total_paid DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Total rebate granted in 2024-25
sql: SELECT SUM(rebate_amount) FROM property_tax_demand WHERE financial_year='2024-25';

question: Properties in wards under Ludhiana zone
sql: SELECT pr.* FROM property pr JOIN boundary b ON pr.boundary_code=b.code JOIN boundary parent ON b.parent_code=parent.code WHERE parent.name='Ludhiana' AND b.type='WARD';
